articles.title: Operation Savage Glory Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: It’s time to put Vinny’s plan into action and get Giorgio’s product back. Get all the details on Chapter 5‘s multi-part mission
articles.body:
It’s time to put Vinny’s plan into action and get Giorgio’s product back. Get all the details on Chapter 5‘s multi-part mission with this official GTA 6 walkthrough for Operation Savage Glory.

Meet up with Vinny on the third floor of the penthouse to begin the mission. Vinny reviews the plan with the team before everyone gears up and moves out for their assignments. This mission has important callouts from Vinny and other members of the crew throughout the various stages of the operation. Be sure to listen so you don’t miss any important details or instructions.

As Lucia, drive the bridge crew to the targeted point on the west bridge. Slow your approach as you get close to the bridge pier and use Square / X to dock when you see the prompt. Exit the boat and move to the middle pillar lit in purple to begin planting bombs. Each explosive needs to be secured on a specific area of the pillar. Your target is marked on the minimap and you’ll see a helpful "Plant Explosive" prompt when you get close.

The charges for the bridge are affixed by magnet. Step up to plant the charge and use the left thumbstick to move the charge around. You’ll hear a loud, buzzing hum when the charge is aligned . Press R2 / RT to set the charge, then Cross / A to arm the explosive.

The second change needs to be planted above the initial charge on a higher point . Access it by climbing the wall where you planted the first charge. When you see the next location, find the right alignment and arm the second charge like you did for the first explosive.

After the second explosive is set, Vinny calls out that a Coast Guard boat is on approach. Hide from them. Rather than getting a gradual bar that fills as they notice you, these guys identify you as a threat instantly if you’re in their line of sight . If you’re spotted Tap to Reveal . If you weren’t spotted, you’ll continue placing charges. The third and final target is even higher. Take the ladder up and stop on the short walkway to place the third explosive.

With the final explosive planted, take the next ladder up and meet the rest of Alpha team at the top of the bridge. Get in the van to move on to the next part of the operation.

With the first part of the plan done, you’ll swap to Jason who is riding with Kevin and Rocco to a cartel ship carrying cocaine that must be destroyed. La Polilla Negra can’t catch a break with you around.

Kevin slows the approach so that you can snipe patrolling cartel members before dropping you and Rocco on the ship. Use D-pad Up and D-pad Down on the D-pad to adjust the zoom of the scope and s nipe as many men as you can as Kevin circles around the ship. The more men you eliminate, the fewer you’ll have to deal with later. As Kevin pulls in closer, he’ll use a spotlight to point out targets for you along with providing verbal callouts.

When it’s clear enough Jason and Rocco drop down onto the ship. You’ll encounter enemies almost immediately and they’re very aware of Rocco. Get them out of the way quickly. They’ll aim toward Rocco as the two of you move through the ship, but the dog is smart. Rocco will survive so long as you don’t let the cartel swarm your location too long.

As you move up from the landing zone, Kevin continues to provide enemy callouts as well as use the helicopter’s spotlight to light the way. As you eliminate enemies directly around you, you can loot their bodies for more ammo, additional weapons, and potentially Zombix or money. The latter won’t do you much good right now, but depending on your aim and how many guys you sniped, you may need the Zombix soon.

Follow Rocco up stairs and around the ship until you reach a container the drug dog just can’t ignore. If you’re not close to Rocco, he’ll bark until you reach the container he's identified. Break in ( Triangle / Y ) using the cut-off tool. Then, push past the bananas and follow Rocco deeper into the container. Open the crate Rocco identifies to find the drugs and plant explosives.

Be cautious exiting the container. More men shoot from the right and some have the high ground. Take cover and eliminate them. Kevin continues to helpfully illuminate enemies as you get rid of this bunch. Reinforcements aren’t ever too far off, so keep moving when most of the enemies are down.

As you follow Rocco off the open platform near the first container, an enemy helicopter flies in. Its guns can shred your body armor and health fast, so take cover fast The easiest way to take out this particular chopper is by shooting the pilot, which is easier to do if you use Combat Focus.

With the helicopter down, follow Rocco down the stairs, moving south. Then, take a right down the hallway. Enemies will more or less be in every area of the ship, so keep your gun up. Rocco moves up the next set of stairs on the right, clearly after something. A man rushes out of cover as you reach the top of the short set of stairs. Rocco moves out of the way, leaving you to deal with the guy and anyone else that follows. Meanwhile, Rocco starts barking wildly.

When it’s safe, move over to Rocco and plant the next explosive . This isn’t a container you can get into, so we’re trusting Rocco on the placement for this one. Just around the corner even more cartel members rush forward. Use the containers and barrels for cover.

Continue forward with Rocco once it’s clear and shoot any remaining opponents. Rocco quickly finds a third target. Plant the explosives on the side of the container.

As you plant the third explosive, you get sneak attacked by a surprisingly strong man. Keep mashing Square / X to fill the bar. Just as it's looking bad, a very good boy takes action. Combat Focus triggers automatically, giving you a chance to return the favor. Now that you’re both on your feet, continue moving through the ship and shoot the numerous cartel members as they pop up around you. Again, if you feel like you’re missing a target, look to see where Kevin’s helicopter light is shining to identify targets.

Follow Rocco up another set of stairs to more enemies. After Rocco successfully eliminates his own prey, he’ll find one more container for you to cut into. After you break in, Jason tosses in the rest of the explosives.

Hold your ground against the onslaught of cartel forces in cover as you wait for Kevin to come around with the helicopter. Rocco hops on fast when Kevin arrives, and you should follow suit as soon as you hear Kevin call out. No matter how many men you sniped early, this part can get gnarly if you stay too long. Kevin pulls away once you’re both in. Wait a few moments as the helicopter flies away, then use D-pad Right on the D-pad to detonate the explosives. Jason reports in and now the rest of the crew has a solid distraction for the Coast Guard.

Alpha moves on to the next part of the preparation phase. Walk with Liz and Vinny to the bridge control building. You can use the snap gun for a quiet entrance, or go loud by breaking open the door. If you choose the latter, you’ll encounter mild resistance from the man working the controls on the second floor of the small building. Either way, get rid of the man and approach the large control panel to raise the bridge. Once the bridge is up, you can plant an explosive on the panel or destroy the control panel with a gun . Before you leave the control room, buff Lucia’s Stamina and Focus with a cup of water from the water cooler if you haven't buffed them already. You can grab an extra bottle of Zombix from the first aid cabinet by the water cooler too.

Move downstairs and detonate the charge if you planted one. Exit the tiny building and regroup with Vinny and Liz. With the mask on, approach the bridge railing and press Cross / A next to it to jump off and into the water. Follow Vinny through the dark green waters. You’ll swim up to the bottom of a Coast Guard boat. Take a charge from Vinny and put it in place. With that, the set up tasks are complete! Swim with Vinny and Liz to a grate.

Here you’ll get a new, brief activity. Line up the drill to one of the massive screws holding the grate in place. Then, press and hold L2 / LT to attach the screwdriver to your target. Hold R2 / RT until the giant screw is completely removed. Do this three more times to get access to the tunnel.

Follow Vinny and Liz through the tunnel as they discuss the other members of the crew. You’ll get a short transition scene at the end of the passage as the trio exits the waterway.

Find the Cocaine in the National Coast Guard Offices

The building you’re looking for is on the southwest part of the small island, and there are many ways to get there. Your weapons are silenced but have live rounds. Still, killing the few patrols while maintaining stealth is completely viable. If you spot a trio of enemies, wait until they’re all marked red . If you shoot one, Liz and Vinny will shoot the other two. Alternatively, you can keep to the shadows and quietly make your way to the offices.

If you get spotted you’ll have to deal with a heavy response from the Coast Guard, though you can absolutely make it through the mission anyway. Liz and Vinny will help if a gunfight breaks out. If you’re interested in combat, I’d recommend prioritizing those group kills on the way to the marked offices rather than doing something that could sound the alarm.

You can run cleanly through this area, quickly, with minimal violence if you want. I’d recommend immediately moving right through the shadows, keeping just outside the base area to avoid detection. If you move fast enough you’ll get across to the corner of the next building before a patrolling car makes it over. Otherwise, you’ll need to wait and let it pass to avoid being spotted .

Then you can quietly walk past the three officers lingering in the street or shoot them. Continue down the street toward the marked office. You’ll spot a single officer sitting in the back of a van. I’d recommend shooting him in the head to get him out of the way, then loot the back of the van.

You’ll find a silenced VF-G1 assault rifle, assault rifle ammo, and a first aid kit with more Zombix. Proceed to the door to the office.

Once you get to the door to the office, use the snap gun to quietly break in if you haven’t sounded the alarm yet. Liz stays behind to guard the entrance. Two doors lead out of this room; rather than going straight (it leads toward a lobby with vending machines and an officer), go through the ajar door on the right . You might run into an officer (you certainly will if the alarm is going off), but otherwise you can quietly proceed through the hallway the room and go right, further into the building.

Vinny splits from you when you reach the staircase, saying he needs to go upstairs to let in the Balkans. Continue straight to a break room. You’ll find a man in either the room or the bathroom. You’ll also find another first aid kit in the bathroom equipped with Zombix and adrenaline. This is a decent place to take a breather if you need to, but don’t linger long.

Through the next pair of double doors, you’ll find one man looking at cargo. You can sneak right past him if the alarm isn’t going off, though I’d recommend knocking him out anyway. The fewer guys walking around the office, the better. Take the double doors through to the depot where you’ll find the drugs Giorgio is after. The positioning of the guards here depends on whether you’ve sounded the alarm.

If you haven’t, you can knock out the two quickly yourself (or use Combat Focus to get fast headshots).

If you have set off the alarm, the guards in the room will be in cover, waiting for your arrival.

When the room is clear, hit the button to open the shutter door and let in the Balkans. No matter how clean you’ve been in the mission up until this point, the Balkans’ arrival causes a ruckus. At least they’re ready to start loading up the product. It’s time to get back to Jason.

You’ve got control of the helicopter back as Jason. Continue flying straight toward the base as Kevin and Jason talk. When you’re close enough, Kevin takes over again and Jason gets in place for another round of sniping. Just as he’s situated, the bridge blows. NOOSE vehicles zoom into the base parking lot shortly after. Use the sniper to deal with the newly arrived agents, but note that you don't have unlimited ammo.

As Kevin hovers around the base, keep an eye out for the orange explosive barrels the NOOSE vehicles conveniently stop by. Tactical explosions can make clearing the area much faster.

After some time sniping, you’ll swap back to Lucia as the crew inside the office building finish putting the cocaine packages in a giant net. The truck pulls the massive ball of cocaine out of the building slowly. Fight off the oncoming NOOSE agents and other security forces as they attempt to stop the truck.

You can swap between Lucia and Jason at any point during the protection phase of the mission. You will need to swap to Jason at one specific point, though. As the response to your mission escalates, a NOOSE agent gets to the roof of the building with an RPG. You must shoot him down before the agent can shoot down your helicopter. You have a few moments to snipe him before he fires. He’s marked with a red arrow.

The RPG operator is only one of several threats on the roof. Eliminating them helps the ground crew too. Around the same time as the RPG operation arrives, a NOOSE helicopter with more agents arrives. Shoot the pilot to eliminate the helicopter, its occupants, and any on the roof below.

Back on the ground, Kevin continues to helpfully shine the spotlight on enemies. Keep pushing through the Coast Guard and NOOSE forces until the truck stops at the next corner. Continue to protect the truck and the product as more enemies flood in. When the truck stops, don’t forget to look out for explosive barrels and listen for callouts from Vinny and his crew as they need help.

After some time defending at the corner, Kevin lowers with winch and you’ll need to run to it as Lucia, leaving the cover fire to everyone else. Grab the winch with Triangle / Y .

A cutscene begins as Lucia attaches the winch. With the drugs secured, the ground team's ride speeds off without Lucia, Vinny, or Liz. Vinny responds by showing everyone what happens when you mix too much cocaine with his trademark Savage Mentality.

Lucia and Liz hop on the side of the net as the helicopter takes off. You can move around the net with the left thumbstick to get some cover from oncoming ground fire, but there isn’t much space. You can’t swap to Jason during this part. Do your best to defend yourself and shoot enemies. You now have unlimited ammo!

It’s not long after liftoff that the Coast Guard deploys its first boats to follow. Detonate the bombs you placed earlier to destroy the first two of many boats.

Look to the opposite side of the net as even more boats pull up. Liz helps shoot at them, but it’s up to you to stop them completely. The gear you have is effective at destroying engines and eviscerating the drivers. Do what you need to stop the boats, then focus on the next two boats that pursue. You might not have time to completely get rid of them as Kevin veers toward the port… and accidentally knocks your support off the net.

At the end of the scene Jason tosses Lucia a new toy with unlimited ammo for you to use for the rest of the chase: a Deever Tech GLR40, a rotary grenade launcher . One shot effectively obliterates most obstacles you’ll face as Kevin takes the helicopter through Vice City.

If you find at any point during the chase that the grenade launcher isn’t precise enough (it can be a challenge to hit a swerving helicopter if it isn’t right behind you), you can always hold L1 / LB and equip a different weapon from your loadout. All weapons on you have unlimited ammo through the duration of the flight, and swapping weapons doesn’t force you to drop the grenade launcher. You can swap back to it whenever you want. You also don’t need to destroy every vehicle that follows, but you will need to destroy the few helicopters that approach when they appear throughout the chase.

Don’t forget to move around the net as you need to and listen to Jason and Kevin’s callouts for specific enemies that pose a greatest risk to the helicopter. You’ll also need to keep an eye on Lucia’s health and use Zombix or adrenaline as needed. The sky lightens as you approach the end of the ride.

The sun comes over the horizon as Kevin flies Jason, Lucia, Rocco, and the massive ball of cocaine to safety. A cutscene closes out the mission, featuring a familiar face seemingly taking custody of Rocco and declaring Giorgio’s life spared. Back at the penthouse Giorgio celebrates. The next morning, Giorgio calls Jason and Lucia to his office to make a move that seemingly gets their names cleared, though he says they still need to work with their lawyer to finalize their deal. In the meantime, Giorgio decides to take an extended vacation, giving you free reign of his penthouse and cars.

Congratulations on getting back your freedom along with access to a sick safe house! You’ll receive $50,000 from Giorgio for the mission not long after you're left along in the penthouse. Giorgio's office and bedroom are locked, but the rest of the luxurious apartment is open to you. You can take some time to hang out in the penthouse, but as soon as you leave you’ll transition to the next mission: Honest Abe .

articles.title: Honest Abe Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: All of Leonida is no longer hunting Jason and Lucia, but they’re not out of the woods yet. In this official GTA 6 Chapter 5 walkthrough, find out what
articles.body:
All of Leonida is no longer hunting Jason and Lucia, but they’re not out of the woods yet. In this official GTA 6 Chapter 5 walkthrough , find out what Abe can offer and what you may want to consider before making your next move.

Leave the penthouse and drive to Abe's office. A cutscene begins as soon as you push through the front door of the law office. Abe isn't pleased, but he’s willing to help. He explains that due to the players in the deal, Jason and Lucia will be able to get basically anything they want. However, once he begins putting the deal together, things are going to move fast. Abe advises you to tie up any loose ends and put any money you may want for the future in a secure savings account – which means to the Family Savings account in BuckMe .

After the meeting as you walk away, Jason and Lucia discuss what it could mean for them to fully max out the savings account. You’ll also get a text about Abe’s fee – you're going to need to pay $150,000 . You’re already a third of the way to that amount thanks to Giorgio's payment, and you’ll have access to anything in your BuckMe from Chapter 4 .

Vice City and the rest of Leonida are open to you again! Your closet, vehicles, and all weapons are once again available too. Now’s a great time to revisit any side activities you enjoy or haven’t yet seen, work on finding collectibles, or finish up optional missions. Here are some handy guides that can help with exploring Leonida:

If you want to continue the main story, you’ll need to pay Abe’s fee to move the deal along – though know there’s no rush or time limit for completing this. You’ll see these new missions listed in the map menu’s Story section:

Unfinished Business – The hard drive deal is being finalized. Use the time to tie up loose ends, or move ahead with Abe’s offer.

Pay Abe’s Fee – Abe’s new deal requires $150,000 before he can proceed. Send the money to the Lucretia Low Group via BuckMe.

As implied, after you pay Abe and meet with him to begin finalizing the deal, you’ll cross into the point of no return. Please only open the spoiler box below if you wish to know what’s locked when you proceed with the deal and how it impacts what’s to come. Paying Abe does not instantly begin the point of no return, so feel free to pay that through BuckMe at any time during your travels.

articles.title: Protective Custody Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: After you've paid Abe for his services and wait for him to reach out, you'll have reached the final stretch of the Grand Theft Auto VI story. In this
articles.body:
After you've paid Abe for his services and wait for him to reach out, you'll have reached the final stretch of the Grand Theft Auto VI story. In this official GTA 6 guide for Chapter 5's Protective Custody, learn how to get through the penultimate mission and the consequences of every choice offered to you.

Warning : This mission is a point of no return for GTA 6.

As always, before beginning this mission I recommend buffing all three of Jason and Lucia's stats. It's also a good idea to save your game before beginning the mission. Approach the doors to the Lucretia Law Group to start Protective Custody. A cutscene begins. Jason asks Lucia if you're really ready to go – one final chance to delay what's coming if you change your mind about starting the mission – before entering. Inside, Abe hands over the pardons and explains that Jason and Lucia need to list every single crime they've done that they want pardoned. Sandy writes as Jason and Lucia recount all your adventures up until this point. At the end of the cutscene, Abe says you need to return to the penthouse to meet with Giorgio, who's finally returned from his retreat. A transition cutscene plays when you arrive at the base of the tower. Giorgio and his security show up not much later, then Jason and Lucia approach Giorgio to find out what they need to do to finalize their deal. Jason is sent away with Dardan to deliver hard drive, while Lucia is asked to stay behind with Giorgio. As Jason leaves, you'll stay as Lucia who is challenged to finish Dardan's game of pool.

Yes, but it is quite difficult. Making the shot doesn't change what comes next.

After you take the shot, you'll swap to Jason who arrives at the art museum with Dardan. He hands Jason a backpack and sends Jason out to deliver the hard drive. Follow the waypoint to a bench by the water and sit. A man comes, picks up the bag, and walks away. The hard drive that's cause so much trouble is finally gone. As you walk back to the car, a cutscene begins. You'll switch back to Lucia in the penthouse as Giorgio makes his call. Lucia gets angry and increasingly suspicious as Giorgio slips out and locks her in the room. Back at the museum, Jason sees NOOSE vehicles just as he's surrounded. There's no way out of this one. NOOSE agents push into the penthouse too. Do your best to resist as Lucia, but there's no getting out.

At the elevator you're joined by a well-dressed woman. The state-wide prosecutor rehashes the awful situation Jason and Lucia are in and the danger they face. She offers a deal; give her the hard drive and Lucia is free, but Jason can't be part of the deal. Without the hard drive, though, all she can offer is menial protection from Mendez's wrath. You'll swap to Jason at the end of the scene. As the prosecutor said, he's sitting in an interview room at the Hamlet police department. It's not long until Mendez steps into the room. He almost immediatly presses Jason for information. The other officer in the room denies Mendez's request to take Jason, and Mendez leaves them with a veiled threat. Walk with the deputy to the cell as directed.

Once Jason is in the cell, you're switched to Lucia, who is sitting in the back of a SWAT truck. The truck isn't on the road long before Mendez's men make their move and the truck is forced off the overpass. Down below, Mendez men move toward the overturned vehicle. You have limited time to escape before they arrive to finish the job. Follow the prompts to break free from the restraints.

Press and hold both triggers, then rapidly press Cross / A to break the chains connecting Lucia to the car.

Press Cross / A again quickly once Lucia recovers the handcuff keys.

You break out of the restraints just in time. Mendez's goons throw open the back doors of the truck, giving Lucia just enough time to grab a gun. Eliminate them and move out of the truck carefully. The truck is surrounded by enemies. Shoot who you need to escape the pond, but don't linger too long. The men will just keep coming. Escape the area in any direction, and not long after you do, a cutscene plays. Lucia calls Abe who also confirms that Jason and Lucia are once again on their own. Use the motorcycle to drive down the dark, rainy highway to the Hamlet precinct. As you do, you may see groups of cop cars zooming down the other side of the highway. Ignore them and keep going until the scene shifts back to Jason.

You're still locked in the cell as the power goes out and Mendez's promised gang attack begins. Deputy Fitzroy arrives to check on Jason. Moments after reaching him, a gang member appears in the doorway. Use Fitzroy's gun to protect yourself (and her). The man isn't wearing body armor, so it doesn't take much to take him down with Combat Focus. Follow Fitzroy as the precinct goes to hell. As she takes cover against the wall, walk left toward the open exit door and barricade it by using Triangle / Y . Pull down the locker with the triggers and Cross / A . Fitzroy suggest going upstairs since the first floor has turned into an uncrossable battlefield. At the top of the stairs, a gang member in body armor pushes through the door. Fight him for his gun with Square / X . Fitzroy reluctantly allows you to keep the good, and good thing too – it's about to get a lot of use. Push through the door and eliminate any enemies that stand between you and the east exit. Fitzroy fights alongside you as you push through the hallway to the room at the end. Fitzroy had originally intended for you to jump over the railing and escape, but the barricade and fire make that plan impossible. Turn around and head for the armory instead. Be sure to cover Fitzroy as she quickly opens the door. If she dies, you'll need to restart from the last checkpoint. After you enter the armory with Fitzroy, a short cutscene plays where the deputy reluctantly agrees to let Jason help. As they gear up, an RPG hits the armory. The room is now lit by flames and has a massive hole that exposes the interior. There's still plenty of gear to grab that can be used to defend yourself. When the scene ends, there's body armor right in front of you. You'll find Zombix and adrenaline in a first aid kit in the back corner of the room, and more weapons in the gun locker.

When you have a scoped weapon, hold L2 / LT and press on the Right Stick Click thumbstick to aim down the sights in first-person. This view is especially helpful for targeting enemies in cover. Thanks to having the high ground, you might find an angle on them.

Once you've spent some time clearing the road with Fitzroy, the two agree that the best next step is to make a run for the warehouse across the road. Jump out the window and run across the street. As you get close to a warehouse, two more men pop out of a white van. Even if you don't kill them, a few shots will get them out of the way long enough for you to make it to the warehouse. Upon entering the warehouse, a short cutscene proves to Fitzroy that Jason was telling the truth about Mendez. Once it's done you'll need to defend the warehouse. Two men move to enter immediately. Use Combat Focus to take them out. Once they're down you can shoot a few more enemies from the door, though if you're low on health, step back and use Zombix. If you don't have any there's a first aid kit on the back wall that has it . Continue to defend the warehouse from cover (don't forget to shoot explosive items out there to clear a few enemies at once) until you're swapped to Lucia.

A short scene plays as Lucia arrives back in Hamlet. Unsurprisingly, police and NOOSE are everywhere. Take cover immediately as a cop car passes. Before running to the warehouse, I recommend exploring at least one of the apartments you start near. Move around the front of the apartment building and you'll see several doors brightly lit on the ground floor and the second floor. The lit white door with the “For Rent” sign in the window on the first floor has a first aid kit in the bathroom and Zombix on the bedside table. You can also use the bathroom to freshen up and eat, drink, or smoke anything you find in the homes to boost Lucia's Health, Stamina, and Focus if you forgot to before beginning Protective Custody. Boosted stats are helpful for what's coming next. Move quickly across the quiet street, aiming for the side of any house. You can try to stealth through the neighborhood, but an officer spots you no matter which path you take around the houses . At this point, it's best to run and break line of sight as best as you can. You'll hear dogs barking too. The louder they are, the closer they are.

If a dog attacks, you can shoot near the dog to scare them away if you'd rather not kill them.

Clear out any NOOSE enemies you spot on the way to the warehouse. As you get close to the warehouse, move toward the back of any NOOSE cars when you see them. The trunks have body armor, ammo, and more weapons. In the SUV truck pictured below, you'll even find a Boomer Launcher (hello, old friend!), and a trauma kit. The Boomer Launcher only has one shot left, so save that for later. After you've successfully killed the initial wave of NOOSE agents, you'll get a sick kill shot to confirm the immediate area is clear. At least for a short moment. A cutscene plays showing Mendez rising out of a truck in the gunner seat of a turret.

If you've still got that Hillinger Boomer grenade launcher, now is a great time to use it. Rather than targeting the vehicle, target Mendez in this fight . After he's taken enough damage – like a direct impact from a grenade launcher – he retreats inside the truck for a brief period while more NOOSE agents arrive on the west and southwest sides of the lot. M endez also takes brief pauses between long instances of shooting the turret . Use the gap to land direct hits on him, or to move between cover if you don't feel safe where you are. If you're running low on ammo or if your body armor gets destroyed, search the back of other NOOSE vehicles to refresh your weapons, armor, and ammo. The standing up against the warehouse building provides reliable cover, but the position can make it a challenge to get an angle newly arriving NOOSE agents due to all the obstacles in the lot. So long as you're in cover, though, you can focus on Mendez. Just don't forget to watch your Health and any approaching agents. Mendez will duck into the truck twice. The third time you wear him down is also the last time . He groans in a cutscene after you cut him down for the third time, clearly injured. The scene shifts to Jason and Fitzroy. Lucia joins them briefly before Jason and Lucia leaveto see what's become of Mendez.

This is a major choice . You can shoot Mendez immediately when you see the prompt, or you can wait and hear him out. He offers to cut Jason and Lucia into his blackmail scheme against Senator Camila Fuentes if you can get a copy of the drive. If you really want to know the outcomes of each choice before you decide, you can open the spoiler box below.

The cutscene after you make your decision changes depending on your choice. No matter what happens, your next mission is The End of the Road .

This walkthrough features some first-person elements. Those come from IGN's GTA 6 Lead Editor, Miranda Sanchez. You can learn more about Miranda and her experience on the About the GTA 6 Guide Editors page.

Up Next: The End of the Road Walkthrough

articles.title: The End of the Road Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The End of the Road is the final mission of Grand Theft Auto VI. All your choices culminate here. In this official GTA 6 walkthrough, learn what you need to do
articles.body:
The End of the Road is the final mission of Grand Theft Auto VI . All your choices culminate here. In this official GTA 6 walkthrough , learn what you need to do to get the hard drive data and what end awaits your adventure.

The way The End of the Road begins depends on what you choose at the end of the previous mission, Protective Custody :

Pick your weapons then head out for the final battle. There’s no wrong choice here, though it’s wise to have at least one weapon with a higher rate of fire. Don’t forget to grab body armor, grenades, and adrenaline too!

A cutscene transitions Jason and Lucia out of their preparation room to Giorgio’s penthouse. As the helicopter approaches Pegassi Towers, Giorgio sees it heading his way and sounds the alarm.

Beginning as Lucia, use the turret to mow down Giorgio's security force as they run out onto the balcony. Combat Focus works great here if you’re having trouble seeing targets. As Jason steers left around the building, he'll call out a man on the upper balcony equipped with an RPG . The man is conveniently marked by an orange arrow. Make him your immediate priority.

Continue destroying the building and Giorgio's men. Anytime you spot one of those orange arrows, make them your kill priority as they’ll be your biggest threat. One hit from an RPG won't take down the helicopter, but a few can. Once you make your way all around the tower, it's time for Jason to make a move. Lucia takes over the helicopter controls, and you swap to Jason as he lands on the balcony of the tower.

Shoot your way through the first two men and prioritize getting indoors so you have better cover. Inside, eliminate anyone else in your way. If it's not clear, Criminal Profile ratings are out the window for this mission.

If you want more firepower than you brought, you can take a quick detour downstairs and grab a rocket launcher from a fallen enemy. The H-AT Launcher will be either on the stairs or somewhere near the bottom of the stairs, depending on where the man carrying it died. The rocket launcher doesn’t have much ammo left nor is it all that efficient for close combat, but it is a lot of fun. You can save it for later in the mission too.

Move forward through the ruins of the penthouse. Just before you move up to the office, you can quickly grab a fresh body armor replacement from the counter along the back wall and with several Zombix from the coffee table on the left. Anytime you find body armor as you raid the penthouse, it’s worth swapping yours out for a new one. Backtracking isn’t a thing in this mission, so use what you have and enjoy what you find .

When it's clear and you're ready, enter Giorgio's office. Aa short scene plays when you’re close to the desk. Jason connects the drive you were given to Giorgio's computer to steal the data from the original hard drive you were carrying around for so long. The traitor, Giorgio, appears across the room. He's safely behind glass for a moment before the brute Dardan appears in a massive helicopter. Jason attempts to escape and falls, getting knocked out. It's Lucia's turn.

As Lucia, do whatever you can to hold off Dardan’s helicopter. Shoot with R1 / RB and try to dodge damage. Don’t worry if you go down fast . This dogfight wasn’t in your favor to begin with – though if you also had a military-grade helicopter, it’d be a different story. Lucia barely makes it to safety on a crane near Pegassi tower.

Lucia calls to Jason, but he's still knocked out. Cover Jason by sniping three guys before they can reach him. After you shoot at the first, two others notice Lucia and shift their attention to her as she's their most immediate threat. Once they’re all down, Lucia shouts until Jason gets up. You swap back to Jason as he stands.

Now as Jason, you need to get back to the office. As you make your way out of the gym and back to the first floor, Lucia provides cover fire when targets are available. You’re knocked down briefly after an explosion by the bar, but it doesn’t keep you down long. Eliminate the targets in the living room. When they’re down, you can pick up another body armor refresh from the coffee table, Zombix, and adrenaline if needed.

Walk out the back and up the ramp and be prepared for more of Giorgio's men as you get close to the top. Where did he get all these guys? In any case, they’re not going to be around much longer with you here. Once you're back in the building you still need to climb the stairs up a flight to reach the floor with Giorgio’s office. Don't forget to use the adrenaline and other resources you have as you need them.

After you slay the guy at the top of the stairs, you'll need to turn right; the original path you took to the office is blocked. Kill the guys who stand in your way and run through the side door by the elevator, through the stairs, and into a door that's always been locked. It leads to a small server room that then feeds into Giorgio's office. Make your way into the office and collect the hard drive.

After you get the hard drive you'll swap to Lucia who is now in danger. Run across the crane until it collapses. Stay alert and watch for a prompt for Lucia to jump to safety. As she does, more rubble falls with the hit from the crane. A large metal piece pins her down.

Now back as Jason, hold L2 / LT and R2 / RT to pull open the elevator doors. Climb down the side of the exposed elevator, then walk across the high beam. You can’t move fast. You’ll move automatically to the next spot to slowly move down, but Jason drops early when the helicopter spots him and shoots.

Jump from the elevator as soon as you see the prompt! You’ll land in the perfect spot to help Lucia. Just by the elevator is another body armor. Put that on before shooting the three men by the balcony. You can wipe them out fast with headshots using Combat Focus. Approach the rail and shoot the other three men below you before hopping down. You can eliminate them when you're on the lower level too, but you’ll have the advantage if you shoot them from above.

With them down, move to Lucia. Hold L2 / LT and R2 / RT to lift the metal debris off her, then mash Cross / A to move the metal together. When she's free, the two scramble away as Dardan spots them.

You now have access to swap between Jason and Lucia. If you have any grenades left or the rocket launcher from before, this is a great place to use them. Lucia only has a pistol since she had to drop her sniper, but you can pick up assault rifles from around the room if you want other weapons.

Fight through the garage and move forward. The character you’re not playing calls out a way up if you linger to explore the ruined garage. Follow them to the back of the garage and eliminate the final guy hiding up there.

A short scene later and you’re challenged with racing around the building, evading the helicopter in an absolutely sick car you weren’t able to take from Giorgio's garage previously – a Granforma Zorrusso. Don’t be tempted to drive too fast, though. You’ll risk flipping the car!

The track ends with a wall, forcing you inside part of the ruined building. It looks like there’s only one way to escape: a stunt jump straight out and across to the next building. Press and hold R2 / RT to rev the engine and get the speed you need to make the jump. As the car flies out of the building, the helicopter with Dardan and Giorgio attempt to meet it.

Time slows as you lean out of the car, focused, and ready to move the final obstacle out of the way of your escape. You can shoot to kill Dardan, the propeller, or both Dardan and Giorgio to safely make it across with the help of Combat Focus. The car spins out when you make it across. Jason and Lucia jump out just in time.

Jason and Lucia get to their feet. Finally, Giorgio is gone. Walk to the elevator and enter to continue. The conversation between the two depends on Jason and Lucia's relationship and who they partnered with to prepare for the final mission.

From here, the end of the mission varies in playable content and potentially includes additional choices depending on several factors. The key ones are:

Jason and Lucia's final relationship standing

Please be careful when scrolling if you do not wish to read any of The End of the Road's final sequence variations. They've all been placed in spoiler boxed that you must click or tap in order to view them.

If You Have a Low Relationship (Partners in Crime or Running on Empty)

And if you have a professional or hardened Criminal Profile :

Or if you have a violent, psycho, or irredeemable Criminal Profile :

If You Have a High Relationship (Crazy in Love or Hot Together)

After the credits roll and final scene plays, you can jump right back into Leonida with a short scene by pressing Continue ( Cross / A ).

This postgame mode allows you to continue playing from before visiting Abe to kick off the final negotiations that led to the end of the game. Learn more about what changes in the postgame guide , and if you’re targeting total game completion, visit the GTA 6 100 Percent Guide .

articles.title: The LEGO Black Friday Sale Is Full of Sets Retiring At the End of 2026
articles.summary: Here are the sets that are likely to sell out fast.
articles.body:
The LEGO Black Friday sale is now live and will run through Cyber Monday. As is tradition, LEGO is now taking orders for the exclusive Black Friday set , which just so happens to be Godzilla this year. If you're not trying to queue up to buy that set, though, the LEGO Store also has a number of worthwhile discounts you can check out now.

The overall best deals here are on sets that LEGO is planning on retiring at the end of this year. Once these sets sell out, they aren't going to get restocked, so this is your last chance to buy them at a discount.

LEGO Black Friday Deals on Retiring Sets

BrickHeadz Eleven, Max, Demogorgon and Holly Figures

It's worth noting that once LEGO officially runs out of a set it has marked as 'retiring soon' , you can essentially consider that set to be retired. That being said, you can usually still find those sets at MSRP somewhere else. So it's not unheard to find a discount on a set that is no longer available at the LEGO Store, but it is uncommon. Some of the sets here are available elsewhere for Black Friday, sometime with a better price

As for what retiring sets are worth grabbing before they're gone, it's difficult to recommend anything else above Wicket the Ewok. He's arguably one of the best parts of Return of the Jedi and is just as adorable as you'd expect in LEGO form. Since it is a Star Wars set , it's also likely to appreciate in value after it is officially retired.

The other set that's likely going to sell out pretty quick is the Volvo L120 Electric Wheel Loader. LEGO construction sets are always some of the most popular builds during these sale times. I actually got sent to a queue when I first tried to click on that page. People just love to build toy versions of heavy machinery.

Last but not least, my personal recommendation is the BrickHeadz Eeyore set . It's currently the only Eeyore build you can buy and it's under $10 right now. There are some rumors swirling that a much larger and more expensive Eeyore set will be arriving next year, but for now, this is worth grabbing at this price. It's the perfect stocking stuffer for any Winnie the Pooh fans out there.

If you're looking for more LEGO deals , there are plenty to go around right now. Amazon and Target have been discounting popular sets for more than a week now. You can check out some of the best deals below:

LEGO Pokémon Iconic Trainer Moments Poké Ball

LEGO Star Wars The Mandalorian's N-1 Starfighter

LEGO Star Wars The Mandalorian: Grogu with Hover Pram

LEGO Star Wars: The Phantom Menace Battle Droid with STAP

LEGO ONE PIECE The Going Merry Pirate Ship

LEGO Shrek: Shrek, Donkey & Puss in Boots

LEGO Technic Lamborghini Huracán Tecnica Orange

With a bachelor's degree in communication and 10 years of professional writing experience, his expertise is spread across a variety of different pop culture topics — from TV series to books and the latest LEGO sets .

articles.title: How to Crack a Safe - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: In preparation for Raul’s cartel heist, Lucia and Nicole need to practice safe cracking. You’ll get the opportunity to do so immediately after
articles.body:
In preparation for Raul’s cartel heist, Lucia and Nicole need to practice safe cracking. You’ll get the opportunity to do so immediately after the GTA 6 Chapter 3 mission Safe Word , but you can get additional time with the safe cracking mini game any time before the heist.

The first time you practice cracking the safe Nicole sets up a failsafe so if you fail, you’re not actually locked out . Getting into the safe requires the following three steps:

You have two meters to match for the left and right triggers. While you can begin with both at once, I find it easier (and faster) to start with the right then to the left. First, match the R2 / RT side. It sometimes requires building pressure, but more often than not in practice you can pull tight and hold it at a high pressure to get it where it needs to be for the remaining step of this mini game.

L2 / LT moves as progress is made and requires a slower increase in pressure, while you’ll need to press and hold R2 / RT steady at a higher pressure. If you press L2 / LT too lightly you won’t make progress (you’re timed). If you press too hard and see the red light, you’ll overheat the drill and need to spend time letting it cool down.

You have a limited amount of time to find and hook the failsafe trigger. The trigger sometimes hides behind objects within the safe, so use the red and white cable as a clue for finding it. The failsafe trigger shines faintly in the dark, so look out for that too.

All objects in this section have sensors that make the failsafe go off, so you must move slowly, carefully, and not hit anything while going for the failsafe trigger. You’ll know you’re getting too close when you see the blue lights around the edge of the screen indicating proximity.

If you find that you’ve moved the hook into a corner and need to double-back, press Triangle / Y to reset . It’s in your best interest to reset if you accidentally navigate to the failsafe's entry point (shown below), which is the wrong end of the cable!

If you’re wondering why you have to hook the failsafe trigger, it’s so that Lucia can hold it in place after Nicole breaks the glass in the door. Breaking the glass normally pulls the trigger and shuts down the safe, but because Lucia is holding onto it when the glass breaks, the safe is still crackable.

The final part is also tough. Nicole is going to break the glass and needs you to hold the failsafe in place. Hold both triggers then get ready to mash X/A as long as Nicole needs you to. If you drop it, the safe can’t be cracked. Nicole will call out the step she’s at so you can know how much time you have left to hold the failsafe.

The last part isn’t easy! If you fail any of the three sections Nicole offers to reset the safe and allow you to retry the section again.

If this mini game isn’t your cup of tea, there’s a setting you can use to make this whole process more straightforward. To do so, pause and go to Settings > Gameplay , then scroll all the way down to Simplified Mini Games . Toggle that on and it’ll apply to the safe cracking.

Drilling into the door : Hold R2 / RT at any pressure

Finding the failsafe trigger : The only way to fail this part is by running out of time. It’s ok if you bump the sides!

Keep the failsafe in place : Press Cross / A to secure the line while Nicole cracks the code.

If you enjoy the other mini games as they are, you can toggle the Simplified Mini Games option (and others in the gameplay menu) anytime!

Successfully opening the safe the first time earns you the following rewards:

You can return to Raul’s Planning Room anytime as Lucia to practice cracking the safe. When you do, you may be challenged to do each step faster and the failsafe trigger’s location moves.

articles.title: The Latest Episodes of Percy Jackson Season 3 Are the Best the Series Has Ever Been, Taking on the First Dark Turn of The Titan's Curse
articles.body:
Warning: This review contains full spoilers for Episodes 3 and 4 of Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3.

After a great season premiere to set up the show's new quest, Percy Jackson Season 3 dives straight into the action with Episodes 3 and 4. The Oracle's prophecy looms and death is in the air. The Greek mythology of it all is on full display as our heroes set out to save Annabeth, encountering ancient monsters and gods along the way. With four episodes down, the series is now firing on all cylinders.

Episode 3 kicks off right where Episode 2 left off. The Oracle has given the prophecy, the quest-goers have been chosen, and the mood is pretty somber. This is the first time in the series so far where we've seen the campers receive a quest that has the word "perish" right there. Artemis' Hunters and members of Camp Half-Blood were chosen to go on the quest, but Percy Jackson is noticeably absent from that list. Like every prophecy, however, the details are up to interpretation and Percy gets a surprising bit of help from Dionysus to bend the threads of fate and sneak him into the quest.

It takes Percy most of the episode to actually be reunited with the rest of the group, which means we get the chance to see Grover truly shine. Grover has been a part of two quests at this point and he knows exactly what to do. Even though he's with a daughter of Zeus and an elite Hunter of Artemis, he takes charge and gets everyone moving in the right direction. Whenever he pulls out that pan flute, you can trust him to find a way to hold everything together. And when he and Percy are finally reunited, he plays an essential role in evading the Spartoi and the taking on the Nemean lion .

And while Percy and Grover are the main drivers of the action in Episode 3, it's Bianca and Nico that bring the emotional depth. We watch Bianca (Olive Abercrombie) go from nervous protective sister to budding demigod warrior and can't help but root for her to succeed. Meanwhile, Nico (Levi Chrisopulos) pushes Percy to bring him along on the quest, showcasing his determination to help his sister. The di Angelo siblings' character development in this episode feels substantial, and it arrives just in time for the biggest tragedy of The Titan's Curse.

Episode 4 is Percy Jackson and the Olympians at its very best. The heroes are on the run from the relentless Spartoi and Nico is forced to part from his sister once again. But not before he makes Percy promise to protect her. This is a pivotal moment in the story, and Walker Scobell does an excellent job of portraying Percy's hesitation to make such a promise. He knows that at least one person is prophesied to perish on this quest, but he has this kid in front of him looking to put his faith in a hero, rather than a god. This promise adds to the weight Percy is already carrying, and things only get heavier for him from here on out.

After escaping the Spartoi (for now), Percy and crew have their first run-in with the gods. Ares is waiting outside a car with obvious hostile intent, which is only intensified by Thalia and Percy taking an equally aggressive stance to the meeting. But thankfully the God of War is only there on behalf of his lover, Aphrodite (Kate McKinnon). She reveals that not only are the gods planning a vote on whether or not to go to war, they will also be voting on whether or not to kill Percy and Thalia. It's their fear that one of the kids will slay the Bane of Olympus and fulfill the great prophecy, but Aphrodite says her vote is for Percy and the power of love. She then gives him the key to her husband's (Hephaestus) junkyard as a boon to help him on his quest.

Their encounter with Aphrodite is a good bit of storybuilding, unravelling just the right amount of the greater prophecy that haunts Olympus. It also sets Thalia down that same path of fear, working to convince Percy that it's now a kill or be killed situation they find themselves in. But the characters don't have much time to ponder the larger threads of fate as the Spartoi force the story forward with their relentless march. This all sets the stage for the reveal of the Junkyard of the Gods , which is a sight to behold.

As you might expect, the Junkyard of the Gods is a massive collection of legendary scrap. Huge piles of rusty metal tower into the sky and the atmosphere has an otherworldly orange desert hue. They may have escaped the Spartoi, but now they are somhwhere that feels dangerous on an entirely different level. It's out of the frying pan and into the fire as Percy and his friends accidentally activate a giant defense robot and find themselves having to split up. At this point, things are getting really serious and tensions are running extremely high.

Like any epic tale, impossible moments like these are what give heroes the opportunity to be heroes. While everyone is split into separate groups, Percy has found himself conveniently in a position where he can still hear everyone else, even if they can't hear him. And what he hears is the same fear that is plaguing Olympus, only it's creeping into the hearts of his companions. As the enormous robot stomps closer, he feels that same fear reaching him. It's only through a fortunate encounter with Tyson (via a magical call) that he is able to come up with a plan and shake that fear.

With a plan in motion, Percy does what he does best and gives a rousing (if somewhat cheesy) speech to the group. Morale is lifted, fear is banished, and the group heads out to shut down the giant automaton currently hunting them. With everyone now working together, Percy is able to successfully reach the entry hatch located in the robot's heel. But he can't open it alone, and the one person he's sworn to protect is the only one that can help him get it open. Bianca's character arc reaches its crescendo as fate puts her in a pivotal position to save everyone, and she leaps at the opportunity.

Fate isn't kind, though. The now lifeless automaton tumbles to the ground with Bianca still inside, fatally wounding her in the process, and fulfilling the second part of the Oracle's prophecy: "One shall be lost in the land without rain." It's a devastating loss. Up until this point, Percy and his friends have made it out unscathed. Now Percy has suffered a massive loss and broken his promise to Nico. He's facing life or death consequences and nothing will ever be the same again after this. This moment is one of the darkest turning points in the entire Percy Jackson series , signalling even more death is on the horizon.
